s = input().strip()

stack = []   # stores indices of '\'
areas = []   # stores areas of individual puddles
total = 0

for i, ch in enumerate(s):
    if ch == '\\':
        stack.append(i)
    elif ch == '/' and stack:
        j = stack.pop()
        area = i - j
        total += area
        # Merge with any existing puddle that lies within this range
        while areas and areas[-1][0] > j:
            area += areas.pop()[1]
        areas.append((j, area))

print(total)
print(len(areas), *[a for _, a in areas])
